scope: Refactors sync_engine + platform_runtime + metadata + finance + communication + academics + reports. Tenant Manifest compiler + edge runtime contract + PWA/offline posture + shared-device mode + low-bandwidth data budget + text-fragment sync + offline payment intent + USSD/IVR adapter contracts + P2P sync posture + disaster backup priority map + School-in-a-Box contract + zero-data local sync posture + offline medical/safeguarding snapshot + NO heavy native app dependency. NO fake hardware deployment claim.

IVR adapter contract — apps.communication.ivr_adapter (telecom partner external blocker)
